response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, senior-level engineer with genuine geospatial credentials (GISCollective, Green Map, FOSS4G talk) and real low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems work at Sociomantic using D with async I/O, fibers, and caching — which maps conceptually onto the routing-tiling problem space. However, the role's core requirement is modern C++ (or Rust) systems development, and his only C/C++ exposure is a six-month stint at National Instruments in 2014-2015 plus a university thesis project; neither C++ nor Rust appears in his skills list, and his last five years have been TypeScript/Node web and product work. He also lacks navigation guidance or routing pipeline experience specifically. Worth a screening call given his systems depth, D-language performance work, and stated appetite for stretching beyond his comfort zone, but he would need a substantial ramp-up on the primary language and domain.
strengths: Genuine geospatial/GIS depth via GISCollective and Green Map platforms
Proven low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems work at Sociomantic
Strong engineering-quality culture: TDD, CI/CD, test tooling, Linux/DevOps
concerns: Modern C++/Rust experience is minimal and over a decade stale
Recent 5+ years focused on TypeScript/Node web and product work
No navigation guidance or routing data pipeline background
